page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m2.2xlarge is a burstable virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor based on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 vCPUs, derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled at 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage or GPU hardware is bundled with this instance type, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core performance is constrained, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core metrics falling into the bottom 10% category. However, multi-core performance is more robust, achieving average tier results in stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth remains in the average tier for both cached small-block reads and uncached large-block reads and writes. Conversely, database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput fall into the weak category, reflecting the burstable CPU allocation model.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation, the ecs.t5-c1m2.2xlarge offers a budget-friendly profile for workloads that do not require continuous high CPU utilization. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for environments with intermittent traffic or background processing tasks. This instance is best suited for development and testing environments, low-traffic web servers, code compilation, and light background processing tasks where CPU usage spikes occasionally but remains low on average.
